deals.postCaption: Have you ever tried dim sum? 🥟 They’re small, bite-sized dumplings with fillings like meat, seafood or vegetables. @happybuddha.wien is a Cantonese spot in Vienna that makes them by hand. There are over 30 kinds to pick from including chicken, pork, seafood and more. 🤭 🥢 The restaurant has been around for 30 years and is now located in the 15th district, close to Mariahilferstraße. They have a pleasant outside seating area with a nice view of the nearby church. 🌳 What is your favorite Chinese food? 📍 Dingelstedtgasse 3, 1150 Wien #simsum #chinesefood #viennafood #wienisst #cantonesefood (invitation)
